mission_05: The proximal loss adds mu/2 * sum(||local_w[k] - global_w[k]||^2) to the data loss for each weight matrix k
The proximal gradient is mu * (local_w[k] - global_w[k]). Add this to the data gradient: w -= lr * (data_grad + prox_grad)
For heterogeneous training, assign different epoch counts to different clients (e.g., random 1-5 epochs). The proximal term prevents divergence despite different amounts of local work
